en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 8. He said: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn reported to me from Muhammad ibn ‘Ali Majilawayh from his uncle Mohammad ibn Abul Qasim, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Muhammad ibn Atiyyah, from Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, that: The Prophet, peace be upon him and his progeny, said:
"Death is an expiateon for the sins of the believers."
